_comment: RHP16 quality gate: Flash-Next on flashnext-4gpu with the production-derived live policy moving experts (the exact policy bc-serve derived for production from the 2026-11-07 calibration record after #708, copied from the ab2 on-arm manifest; the KL run's settings change the calibration key, so it is passed explicitly), scored by radiance KL mode against the rad116 BF16 reference (rad-kld-corpus-4, 8,240 rows). Control: the R9700 alone (helper-off). The live heat feed is recorded every second, as in the calibration run, so the policy's derived gate (89 heat windows) opens part-way through the corpus; rows scored after the first committed transaction are judged separately. engine.ngram_placement=disk in both arms: KL mode scores the target model's logits and never drafts, and the 47.7 GiB pinned table plus the 45 GiB host pool do not fit (first try: out of memory at start-up). R3_MOE_WORKER=1 only in the policy-on arm (the engine still reads it from the environment; the control has no helper). calibration_run=true with the explicit live_policy: bc-serve takes a lab --live-policy only with --experiment (non-empty) or --calibration-run; the latter is the mode the calibration's own moves ran in, and the manifest carries the derived policy unchanged. engine.num_speculative_tokens=0 in both arms: KL mode drafts nothing and refuses a speculative depth. Try 5: the engine still reads the route-histogram file and period from R3_MOE_WORKER_HISTOGRAM(_PERIOD_S) in its environment (try 4 wrote no heat file: heat_invalid, no moves), so the policy-on arm sets both; arm policy-off is the same 4-GPU layout with no policy, the attribution baseline for policy-on (the helper-off gate alone repeats RAD46's static-tail p99.9).
